niche: a boundary commission's electoral review of a district's 23 wards, each ward's electors on the register to be published after the 2032 canvass forecast from six canvasses of the register at property level, the address register and the council's housing trajectory, where a new dwelling's electors join the register over several canvasses after it is completed
analyst_test: A strong analyst conforms the 1 December 2026 register to wards, adds every dwelling the trajectory places before the 2032 canvass at the settled stock's electors per dwelling by dwelling type, keeps each existing dwelling at its 2026 count, and flags the wrong set of wards outside ten per cent of the average electors per councillor.
domain_test: The 2032 electorate is the register's coverage of each dwelling's electors by the number of canvasses since it was completed, the completeness-by-length-of-residence the electoral field measures, applied dwelling by dwelling to the 2032 canvass; swap electors for pupils on a school roll and the build-up disappears, because a pupil is on roll from the day of admission.

world.geography: an unnamed UK-like country with individual electoral registration and an annual canvass (the district, its commission and the people are invented)
world.org_type: a national local government boundary commission

driver: A new unit's contribution to a register builds up over several annual rounds after the unit is created toward the level settled units hold, so a forecast that keeps each existing unit at its present count and adds the units still to come at the settled units' yield, or at the yield the newest units show today, misses both the recent units still building up and the units that will still be young at the horizon, while a uniform completeness factor moves nothing.
driver_concrete: Each new dwelling's electors join the register over the canvasses after it is completed, toward the settled stock's electors per dwelling by type; the 2032 forecast ages every dwelling completed since 2020 and every dwelling the trajectory places before the 2032 canvass to its number of canvasses at December 2032.
stump: The default path adds the trajectory's dwellings at the settled stock's electors per dwelling by type to the 1 December 2026 register and flags the wards whose late-phase sites it counts as full, missing the wards whose estates completed since 2022 are still joining the register.

differentiation.task235: task235 judges an item lost only once its device has had its next chance to send, read from a real-time contact log; here nothing is lost or waiting to be sent: every dwelling is on the address register and its electors join the register over the canvasses after completion, so the forecast ages each dwelling, built or still to be built, to its canvass count at the horizon.
differentiation.task445: task445 completes holders whose reports have not arrived from each holder's last report and a class drift; here every register has been published and nothing is unreported: a dwelling's electors build up over canvasses toward a settled level, and the step ages dwellings that do not yet exist to their canvass count at the horizon.
differentiation.task481: task481 restates a count onto a new classification by conversion rates whose short window over-represents one kind of record; here no classification changes: a dwelling's electors build up over the canvasses after it is completed, and the forecast ages each dwelling to the 2032 canvass.
